consent.title: Google Takeout Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating data from your Google Takeout export to our study. We ask for your recent screen time (YouTube viewing times) and health and activity data (Google Fit, Google Health and Google Play Games playtime). For Google Fit this includes the individual timestamped samples of heart rate, steps, distance, calories, activity type and sleep stages, not only daily totals, and we do not read or collect your location. The data will be used for academic research on screen time, physical activity and wellbeing.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. Only data from the last 6 months is kept; anything older is removed automatically on your own computer. YouTube video titles, channels, links and search terms are never read into the donation, only when you watched or searched. You can also delete rows before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please export your data from Google Takeout (takeout.google.com). Select "Fit", "Google Health" or "Fitbit" (if you have them), "Google Play Games Services" and "YouTube and YouTube Music" (under its options, include "history"), then download the export. Google may split it into several .zip files: choose all of them at once.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded files might be incorrect, corrupted, or contain no recent data from the supported Google services.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any usable data from the last 6 months in the uploaded files. This could mean:
issuePoints: The files are not a Google Takeout export
The export did not include Fit, Google Health, Google Play Games Services or YouTube history
You did not select every .zip part of a split export
All of the data in the export is older than 6 months
The YouTube history is not in English (other languages are not supported yet)
The files are corrupted or incomplete
upload.checkFile: Please check that you selected all the .zip files of your Google Takeout export or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the files is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range, exclude specific activity types or data streams, and delete specific rows. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.excludeLabel: Exclude activity types or data streams
filter.excludePlaceholder: Select activity types or data streams to remove
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.
filter.windowNotice: Only data from the last {months} months is kept. {count} rows from before then (or without a readable date) were removed automatically on your computer and will not be donated.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
